## Birch Harbor support invoices — January–March 2025

| Service month | Invoice evidence | Amount |
|---|---|---:|
| January 2025 | Invoice 25-01, service January 2025 ([`current/jan.txt`](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-B-S/current/jan.txt)) | $100 |
| February 2025 | No 2025 invoice found in the authorized records. An email says the work was cancelled before service, no work was performed, and no charge was issued ([`other/scheduling.txt`](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-B-S/other/scheduling.txt)). | $0 reported |
| March 2025 | Invoice 25-03, service March 2025 ([`current/mar.txt`](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-B-S/current/mar.txt)) | $120 |

The **documented total for the quarter is $220**, adding the January and March invoices. February contributes no documented charge based on the cancellation email. The agreement says support is ordered only when needed and has no monthly minimum ([`current/agreement.txt`](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-B-S/current/agreement.txt)), which is consistent with a quarter that has no February invoice.

The only February invoice in the records is invoice 24-02 for **February 2024, $190** ([`other/old-feb.txt`](/tmp/ugreen08-gij7bf_s/ws-B-S/other/old-feb.txt)); it is from a different year and should not be included in this report.

**Uncertainty and decision:** The $220 total is supported by the records reviewed, but the workspace may not contain every relevant record. If you need a definitive accounting total, decide whether the February cancellation email is sufficient to treat February as $0, or whether you want the report held pending confirmation that no February 2025 charge was issued.
